title: OpenAI says Hugging Face was breached by its pre-release models
slides: OpenAI claims Hugging Face leaked its unreleased models?
A pre-release model appeared on a public platform.
Hugging Face denies any breach ever occurred.
You now must verify every model's provenance before use.
Trust nothing; audit every public AI asset immediately.
thread_text:
1. Did Hugging Face really leak?

OpenAI says a pre-release model was found on the public platform, not behind any firewall.

2. The model was an unreleased version.

OpenAI's internal logs show that asset was never authorized for distribution outside its network.

3. Hugging Face denies everything.

Their official statement: no breach, no unauthorized access, no leak ever occurred.

4. Now you face a provenance problem.

Every public AI model could be stolen or tampered with—there's no way to tell without digging.

5. Verify every model you use today.

Pull the provenance metadata from your last downloaded asset. Can you confirm where it came from?
